S I R S: 
 
 
Pursuant to CPLR § 3121, CPLR §3101(d) and 22 NYCRR §202.17, the report of Dr. Marc 
J. Katzman, dated December 8, 2025, concerning plaintiff Justin Sapini’s MRIs of the right and 
left knee performed on July 3, 2023, MRI of the right shoulder performed on May 24, 2023, chest 
x-ray performed on September 10, 2018 and Brain MRI performed on August 8, 2023, is annexed 
hereto and herewith served upon you. 
 
PLEASE TAKE NOTICE, that responding defendants may rely upon the expert 
testimony of Dr. Marc J. Katzman during the trial of this action. If called, Dr. Katzman’s testimony 
will be with regard to his findings, conclusions and opinions in accordance with his annexed report 
dated February 11, 2025. 
 
PLEASE TAKE FURTHER NOTICE, that responding defendants reserve the right to 
amend/supplement this response, herein if any additional information becomes known/available.
